description: This file contains helper functions for managing Git repositories, including initializing repos, committing data, managing tags, pushing updates, and retrieving test run information, primarily in the context of openembedded build environment automation.

classes.name: ArchiveError
classes.description: Custom exception for internal error handling within the script

classes.name: TestedRev
classes.description: Named tuple to store information about tested revisions including commit, commit_number, and tags

methods.name: format_str(string, fields)
methods.description: Formats a string using the provided fields and raises an ArchiveError if a key is missing

methods.name: init_git_repo(path, no_create, bare, log)
methods.description: Initializes a local Git repository at a specified path, with options to create or verify existing repositories

methods.name: git_commit_data(repo, data_dir, branch, message, exclude, notes, log)
methods.description: Commits data into a Git repository, including handling exclusions, notes, and updating branch references

methods.name: expand_tag_strings(repo, name_pattern, msg_subj_pattern, msg_body_pattern, keywords)
methods.description: Generates tag name and message strings, supporting incremental tag numbers based on existing tags

methods.name: gitarchive(data_dir, git_dir, no_create, bare, commit_msg_subject, commit_msg_body, branch_name, no_tag, tagname, tag_msg_subject, tag_msg_body, exclude, notes, push, keywords, log)
methods.description: Main function to orchestrate archiving data into a Git repo, tagging, and pushing to remote repositories

methods.name: get_test_runs(log, repo, tag_name, **kwargs)
methods.description: Retrieves and sorts test run information matching a tag pattern from a Git repository

methods.name: get_test_revs(log, repo, tag_name, **kwargs)
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all tested revisions along with their tags from a repository

methods.name: rev_find(revs, attr, val)
methods.description: Searches for a specific value within a list of TestedRev objects based on an attribute

ctags.name: git_commit_data
ctags.pattern: /^def git_commit_data(repo, data_dir, branch, message, exclude, notes, log):$/
ctags.signature: (repo, data_dir, branch, message, exclude, notes, log)

ctags.name: gitarchive
ctags.pattern: /^def gitarchive(data_dir, git_dir, no_create, bare, commit_msg_subject, commit_msg_body, branch_n/
ctags.signature: (data_dir, git_dir, no_create, bare, commit_msg_subject, commit_msg_body, branch_name, no_tag, tagname, tag_msg_subject, tag_msg_body, exclude, notes, push, keywords, log)
